title: Interleaver Benchmark Suite: parameter provenance, metric taxonomy and validated metrics (code)
description: MATLAB implementation of the interleaver evaluation suite of 'A Code-Aware Evaluation Framework for Interleavers Under Burst Errors: Metric Taxonomy, Validation, and Parameter Provenance': canonical interleaver implementations with declared parameter rules, the length-grid generator, precomputed permutation tables, the metric implementations, the simulation harness, the drivers of the five further campaigns, and the analysis scripts that regenerate every table and figure of the article and its Supplementary Material. Release 1.1.0 adds the shortened Reed-Solomon code, the further-campaign modes and drivers, the permutations at their lengths, and their analysis; no number of the primary campaign changes. The campaign data are archived separately (see related identifiers).
